text:
Anya Feldman: Postmortem summary: recurring cold-start latency spikes during Dedicated scale-up windows. Root cause looks like concurrent model init + prefix KV warm leading to request queuing and fallback to smaller variant. Need concrete tests and owners so this doesn't slip.

Priya Singh: Agreed. Proposed follow-ups: 1) a replay regression that replays traffic across scale-up boundaries (use captured traces), 2) a micro-benchmark to exercise model init path (measure init time vs active requests), 3) a promptset that stresses long-prefix KV warm behavior.

Caleb Tran: I can own the replay regression harness. Plan: build a small runner that replays requests with timing offsets, run nightly against staging for 2 weeks. Reproducer repo: https://github.com/redwood/repro/tree/scaleup-replay (WIP).

Diego Morales: I'll take the promptset + eval harness. Promptset will include short/long context pairs, streaming vs non-streaming modes, and checks for variant selection. Will add expectations for no fallback on 95% of traces. Target PR by Thu.

Priya Singh: Ops asks: add alerting if nightly replay increases p95 by >20% vs baseline for 3 consecutive runs. Also surface model-init duration metric in the dashboard.

Anya Feldman: Ownership recap: Caleb -> replay harness + CI job (due Mon), Diego -> promptset + eval PR (due Thu), Priya -> alert + dashboard (due Wed). ops-bot create ticket and schedule 20m sync.

ops-bot: Created ticket #INC-4219 "scaleup-coldstart: regression + init-benchmark" assigned to Anya Feldman, due 2025-02-01. Sync scheduled: 2025-01-06 14:00 UTC.

Caleb Tran: Repro notes: use `replay_runner --trace traces/scaleup/2025-01-02.json --speed 1x --preserve-timestamps` to reproduce locally. Adding a small CI matrix: staging/stress.

Diego Morales: Example expectation in eval harness:
```
assert variant_used != "tiny" or fallback_count < 0.05
```
I'll include a toy model fixture so CI doesn't depend on full infra.

Priya Singh: Dashboard panels: scaleup_replay/p95, model_init_time, fallback_rate, queue_depth. I'll add them to the incident ticket.

Caleb Tran: Also proposing a short chaos drill: perform a controlled scale-up while synthetic traffic runs and validate no user-facing fallbacks. Can run as a one-off after nightly regression stabilizes. 

Anya Feldman: Timeline check: replay CI up Mon, dashboards/alerts Wed, promptset PR Thu, chaos drill targeted week of 2025-01-13. If any slippage ping me.

Diego Morales: Opening PR: https://github.com/redwood/repro/pull/701 (draft). Includes promptset and a small smoke eval.

Caleb Tran: I'll wire the nightly job: `ci/jobs/scaleup_replay.yml` and link traces.

Priya Singh: Will add alert to #eng-oncall and a short runbook snippet in the ticket for oncall to triage.

Anya Feldman: Great — thanks. We'll close this thread once INC-4219 shows all tasks in progress. :thumbsup:
